identitySupervision: Expert-correct components only; unknown components are masked.
validitySupervision: Correct components pair the true class with each alternative vocabulary class; train on the three highest-scoring alternatives. Expert errors deny the expected component, without guessing actual identity.
outputCombination: Normalized identity probability times validity, retaining the full vocabulary.
nativeClipPolicy: Only source-transcribed realized pinyin with unflagged candidate boundary and target inside baseline vocabulary; training only.
eduhkUsage: Research only; weakly aligned source-annotated component substitutions, no human clip review; withheld speakers untouched.
